correctness.rationale: For distinct palindrome centers, their symmetric equality matchings have a forest union because composing reflections translates each position by a nonzero displacement; thus uniform iid q-ary joint thresholds factor as q^{-(r+s)}. For n>=3, covariance of radius-one indicators X1=X2 and X1=X3 equals Var(p_X1), vanishing iff the supported law is uniform. Same-center tails are nested, yielding the stated exact same-parity covariance formulas and mixed parity zero, and summable capacity boundary corrections give variance slope 2q/(q-1)^2. Independent small binary/ternary word enumeration reproduced cross-length covariance and paired centers.
residual_risks: Pairwise does not imply full mutual independence; literal versus reverse-complement palindromes and occurrence versus distinct words must not be conflated.
